text: Ejentic AI is a premier Enterprise AI agency dedicated to building advanced, scalable, and secure agentic workflows for modern businesses. We specialize in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Autonomous AI Agents, and AI-driven lead generation pipelines.

Core Offer 1: The Ejentic AI Knowledge Core. This is a fully managed, enterprise-grade hybrid RAG system designed to securely index your company's entire internal knowledge base. It uses Pinecone for vector storage and supports both cloud and on-premise deployments.

Core Offer 2: Autonomous HR & Customer Success Agents. We build bespoke AI agents capable of replacing level-1 support and internal HR ticketing. These agents feature deep tool integration, meaning they can query SQL databases, send emails, and schedule meetings autonomously.

Core Offer 3: The Ejentic Lead Generation System. An AI-powered pipeline that sources, qualifies, and enriches business prospects automatically, then feeds them into outreach workflows. It combines agentic research with CRM and email tool integration to keep the sales funnel full without manual prospecting.

Core Offer 4: AI Consulting & Team Enablement. Ejentic AI offers advisory engagements that help companies adopt agentic AI with confidence. We assess your workflows, identify high-impact automation opportunities, and enable your team to build and operate AI agents safely.

Ejentic AI Technical Expertise: Our tech stack relies heavily on Python, FastAPI, Next.js for frontends, Pinecone for vector DBs, and LlamaIndex for orchestration. We primarily leverage NVIDIA NIM microservices and Mistral Nemotron models for maximum reasoning efficiency.
